note: Hand-kept list of consulates and embassy consular sections in the U.S. Each office's street address and main public line come from its own government's pages (foreign ministry, embassy or consulate site; 'source' is the page read), cross-checked against the U.S. State Department's per-country consular contact list ('roster'). Honorary consuls (private individuals) are left out, as are people's names and emails. Coordinates from the U.S. Census geocoder ('located': 'zip' = the ZIP area, the address itself did not match). Retrieved 2026-10-23. Rebuild with scripts/build_consulates.py.

AF.status_en: There is no Afghan embassy or consulate in the United States. The U.S. State Department says to contact the Afghan embassy in Ottawa, Canada, or the consulate in Ontario, Canada.
AF.status_es: No hay embajada ni consulado de Afganistán en Estados Unidos. El Departamento de Estado de EE. UU. indica comunicarse con la embajada afgana en Ottawa, Canadá, o con el consulado en Ontario, Canadá.
AF.domains: No offices listed, so no hosts.

BR.domains: www.gov.br is Brazil's federal government portal; /mre is the Ministério das Relações Exteriores (Itamaraty) and each consulate-general has its page under it. econsular.itamaraty.gov.br is the e-Consular system linked from the MRE's own 'Sistema e-consular' page; itamaraty.gov.br is the MRE's domain under gov.br.

CN.domains: us.china-embassy.gov.cn: .gov.cn is the PRC government domain; china-embassy.gov.cn is the Foreign Ministry's embassy-site namespace (Embassy in Washington). newyork/sanfrancisco/losangeles/chicago.china-consulate.gov.cn: subdomains of china-consulate.gov.cn, the Foreign Ministry's consulate-site namespace under .gov.cn.

CO.domains: consulado.gov.co is the Colombian Foreign Ministry's (Cancillería) consulate domain under .gov.co, Colombia's government TLD. Every <city>.consulado.gov.co host is the official site of that consulate, as listed in the 'Página web' field of the Cancillería directory (tramites.cancilleria.gov.co). Their footers read 'Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores'.

CU.status_en: Walk-in service is open at the Consular Office in Washington. Hours: Monday-Friday 9:00 AM-12:00 PM, plus Monday, Wednesday and Friday 2:00-4:00 PM (Nota Informativa No. 1/2026). Requests can also be made by mail or through agencies under contract with the Consular Office. This is the only Cuban consular office in the US.
CU.status_es: La Oficina Consular en Washington atiende en persona de lunes a viernes de 9:00 a 12:00, y además lunes, miércoles y viernes de 2:00 a 4:00 p.m. (Nota Informativa No. 1/2026). También se pueden hacer trámites por correo postal o por las agencias que tienen contrato con el Consulado. Es la única oficina consular de Cuba en EE. UU.
CU.domains: misiones.cubaminrex.cu is the missions portal of cubaminrex.cu, the official domain of Cuba's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MINREX). Cuba uses the .cu ccTLD and its pages also link the alias misiones.minrex.gob.cu.

DO.domains: usa.mirex.gob.do is the Dominican Embassy in the US site, hosted under mirex.gob.do, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MIREX) domain under .gob.do, the Dominican government TLD. Its consulates list (usa.mirex.gob.do/consulados/) links each consulate's portal at usa.mirex.gob.do/consular/<city>/.

EC.domains: www.cancilleria.gob.ec is the site of Ecuador's Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores y Movilidad Humana under gob.ec, Ecuador's government domain. citas.cancilleria.gob.ec is the Foreign Ministry's own consular appointment system ('Citas Cancillería'), a subdomain of the same ministry domain.

GT.domains: embaguateusa.gob.gt is under gob.gt, Guatemala's government domain; it is the Embassy of Guatemala in the United States (its contact address is @minex.gob.gt and it links to minex.gob.gt, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs).

HN.domains: sreci.gob.hn is the Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores y Cooperación Internacional (Foreign Ministry) of Honduras; gob.hn is the Honduran government domain.

HT.domains: ambetatsunis.gouv.ht is the Haitian Embassy in the US site under .gouv.ht, Haiti's government TLD (the old haiti.org redirects there with HTTP 301). Each consulate host follows the same pattern: cgatlanta.gouv.ht, cgboston.gouv.ht, cgchicago.gouv.ht, cgmiami.gouv.ht and cgnewyork.gouv.ht are the Consulates General, and conorlando.gouv.ht is the Consulate in Orlando. The Foreign Ministry's directory (mae.gouv.ht) links every one of these hosts as the mission's website.

IN.domains: indianembassyusa.gov.in: .gov.in is the Government of India's reserved domain (NIC); it is the Embassy of India in Washington site. indiainnewyork.gov.in, cgisf.gov.in, cgichicago.gov.in, cgihouston.gov.in, indiainatlanta.gov.in, indiainseattle.gov.in, indiainla.gov.in: all .gov.in government domains, each listed as the consulate's website on the Embassy's official 'Consulates in US' page.

KR.domains: overseas.mofa.go.kr: .go.kr is the Republic of Korea's government domain, and mofa.go.kr is the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; each site footer says it is the official e-government website of the Republic of Korea.

id_note.en: Mexican consulates issue Mexican passports and the Matrícula Consular de Alta Seguridad (high-security consular ID card) to Mexican nationals, by appointment through MiConsulado.
id_note.es: Los consulados de México expiden pasaportes mexicanos y la Matrícula Consular de Alta Seguridad (identificación consular) a personas mexicanas, con cita previa a través de MiConsulado.

MX.domains: consulmex.sre.gob.mx is the consular-sites host of sre.gob.mx, the domain of the Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (Mexico's Foreign Ministry) under gob.mx, Mexico's federal government domain; every Mexican consulate in the US publishes its official site there (each linked from the SRE page "Representaciones de México en Estados Unidos" on gob.mx). citas.sre.gob.mx is the SRE's official MiConsulado appointment system, named on the SRE page "Citas telefónicas y a través de internet" (gob.mx/sre) and linked from the Embassy site embamex.sre.gob.mx/eua and from consulate sites.

NI.status_en: No official Nicaraguan government page with its consulates' street addresses could be reached in October 2026 (cancilleria.gob.ni did not respond). The U.S. State Department lists Nicaraguan consular offices in Washington, Miami and New York, with phone numbers only.
NI.status_es: En octubre de 2026 no se pudo abrir ninguna página oficial del gobierno de Nicaragua con las direcciones de sus consulados (cancilleria.gob.ni no respondió). El Departamento de Estado de EE. UU. menciona oficinas consulares de Nicaragua en Washington, Miami y Nueva York, solo con números de teléfono.
NI.domains: No hosts used. Nicaragua's Foreign Ministry domain cancilleria.gob.ni (gob.ni = Nicaraguan government) did not resolve on 2026-10-23, and its appointment subdomain rejected every request.

PE.domains: www.gob.pe is the Plataforma Digital Única del Estado Peruano, the Peruvian state's single official portal, where the Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores (gob.pe/rree) and each 'Consulado General del Perú en <city>' have their official institution pages.

PH.domains: honolulupcg.dfa.gov.ph: subdomain of dfa.gov.ph, the Philippine Department of Foreign Affairs domain under the .gov.ph government namespace, listed as the Honolulu post's website on the Chicago and New York consulates' official post lists. houstonpcg.dfa.gov.ph: subdomain of dfa.gov.ph (Department of Foreign Affairs), listed as the Houston post's website on the New York consulate's official Consulate Finder page.

SV.domains: No office web links or appointment URL are used. Addresses come from rree.gob.sv, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of El Salvador; gob.sv is El Salvador's government domain.

UA.domains: usa.mfa.gov.ua, ny.mfa.gov.ua, chicago.mfa.gov.ua, san-francisco.mfa.gov.ua, houston.mfa.gov.ua: subdomains of mfa.gov.ua, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine under the .gov.ua government domain. online.mfa.gov.ua: the MFA's online consular appointment system (same .gov.ua domain), which the New York consulate's contact page names as the place to book appointments.

VE.status_en: As of 2026-10-23 no official source confirms an open Venezuelan consular office anywhere in the US. Relations were broken in 2019 and the embassy and all consulates closed. On 2026-03-05 the US State Department announced that the US and Venezuela's interim authorities agreed to re-establish diplomatic and consular relations, and the US Embassy in Caracas resumed operations in March 2026. No State Department or Venezuelan government page found gives a reopening date, address or services for a Venezuelan consulate in the US. Venezuela's Foreign Ministry site (mppre.gob.ve) was unreachable (HTTP 503) and could not be checked.
VE.status_es: Al 23 de octubre de 2026, ninguna fuente oficial confirma que haya un consulado de Venezuela abierto en EE. UU. Las relaciones se rompieron en 2019 y cerraron la embajada y todos los consulados. El 5 de marzo de 2026, el Departamento de Estado de EE. UU. anunció que EE. UU. y las autoridades interinas de Venezuela acordaron restablecer las relaciones diplomáticas y consulares, y la Embajada de EE. UU. en Caracas volvió a operar en marzo de 2026. No encontramos ninguna página oficial con fecha de reapertura, dirección o servicios de un consulado venezolano en EE. UU. El sitio de la Cancillería venezolana (mppre.gob.ve) no respondía (error 503) y no se pudo revisar.
VE.domains: No office is listed, so no host is used. Venezuela's government domain is .gob.ve: mppre.gob.ve is the Foreign Ministry and eeuu.embajada.gob.ve is the embassy pattern. Both returned HTTP 503 to curl and WebFetch on 2026-10-23.

VN.domains: No office web link is on a Vietnamese government domain: the Embassy (vietnamembassy-usa.org) and the San Francisco (vietnamconsulate-sf.org) and New York (vietnamconsulate-ny.org) consulate sites are on .org, so all 'web' fields are null. The MOFA-hosted mission sites (*.mofa.gov.vn, e.g. vnconsulate-houstontexas.mofa.gov.vn) could not be reached from here (connection refused or timed out).
